1. Executive Summary

Throughout the 2025/2026 Formula Student season, the vehicle logged 118 raw data files spanning four competition and testing venues: Cantoblanco (shakedown & bench tests), Austria (Red Bull Ring), Barcelona (Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya), and Jarama. This report provides a complete multidisciplinary engineering assessment of safety shutdowns, accumulator cell balancing, dynamic internal resistance, throttle/brake plausibility, chassis dynamics, and driver performance.

2. Fault Patterns, Safety Loop & Root-Cause Failure Analysis

Every safety shutdown and state machine transition anomaly across the season was isolated, chronologically reconstructed, and categorized into an authoritative taxonomy.

Key Root Cause Finding: 524W DCDC Converter Precharge Divider
During precharge, the un-isolated 524W DC-DC converter continuously drew auxiliary current, effectively presenting an equivalent load resistance of 141.4 Ω across the high-voltage bus. In series with the 47 Ω precharge resistor, this formed a rigid 3:1 voltage divider clamping the precharge voltage to exactly:
V_bus = V_pack * [141.4 / (47 + 141.4)] = 0.7505 * V_pack (~270.2 V).
Since 75.05% is below the required 90.0% threshold, the BMS timed out after exactly 5.00 seconds, transitioning to FSM Error state 5 and causing 166.5 W of continuous thermal dissipation in the precharge resistor.

Contactor Mechanical Shock & Harness Fretting

In sessions LOG0074 and LOG0093, high-rate 100 Hz IMU telemetry revealed acceleration jerk spikes exceeding 0.05g (peaking at 0.077g) exactly 250 ms prior to the BMS latching thermistor disconnect (fault=13, NtcDisc) or module offline (fault=2). This proves that the physical contactor de-energization clunk mechanically vibrated the accumulator wiring harness pins, interrupting the thermistor return loop.

Regulatory Pedal Plausibility (Rule EV 2.3)

During Austria Endurance Stint 2 (row 149, t = 220.504s), the driver applied 97.46% throttle (apps1_raw = 3382) while simultaneously actuating the brake pedal (brake_raw = 607 > 600 threshold). The VCU correctly enforced mandatory Rule EV 2.3, clamping motor torque to 0% and latching torque suppression for 7.87s until the driver lifted below 5% throttle.

5. Actionable 2026/2027 Engineering Recommendations

To eliminate failure modes and enhance vehicle performance for the 2026/2027 season car, the engineering team must implement the following mandatory upgrades:

1. High-Voltage DCDC Precharge Isolation Relay (Critical)

Root Cause: The auxiliary 524W DCDC converter is hardwired to the high-voltage bus, forming a 141.4 Ω load in series with the 47 Ω precharge resistor, clamping voltage to 75.05% and causing 7 precharge timeouts.

Action for 2026/2027 Car: Install a high-voltage solid-state relay or delayed enable contactor on the DC-DC input. Program the VCU to keep the DC-DC converter isolated until the Main Positive AIR closes and DC bus voltage exceeds 90% of pack voltage.

2. Accumulator NTC Harness Strain Relief & Mechanical Shock Decoupling

Root Cause: Contactor de-energization clunks produce mechanical shocks (|Δa| > 0.05g) that transfer through the accumulator chassis, vibrating harness pins and triggering false NTC disconnect shutdowns.

Action for 2026/2027 Car: Replace slip-fit connectors with automotive-grade latching connectors (Molex Micro-Lock Plus). Mount main contactors on elastomeric Shore 50A dampers decoupled from the BMS enclosure. Introduce a 400 ms software debounce in BMS firmware for thermistor faults.

3. Module 3 Cell Balancing Routine & Busbar Resistance Audit

Root Cause: Module 3 exhibited over 300 mV intra-module cell spread under high discharge, with cell c3_12 dropping to 2,782 mV.

Action for 2026/2027 Car: Implement an automated active balancing cycle during charging targeting <10 mV delta. Audit and re-torque Module 3 inter-cell busbars to 2.5 N·m to ensure uniform contact resistance.

4. Driver Pedal Box Ergonomics & EV 2.3 Throttle/Brake Spacing

Root Cause: Driver trail-braking foot overlap in Austria Stint 2 triggered Rule EV 2.3, completely disabling motor torque for 7.87s.

Action for 2026/2027 Car: Increase lateral pedal spacing between throttle and brake by 15 mm. Install a dashboard visual/acoustic chime when brake pressure exceeds 400 counts with throttle >20%.
